tasks.title: Recreate local Python environment
tasks.description: Recreate .venv in the current workspace path and install the project with test dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: python -m pip install -e '.[test]' completes
pytest is runnable from the recreated environment
README install instructions remain accurate

tasks.title: Run and stabilize test suite
tasks.description: Run the existing tests and resolve any failures that are not caused by local environment drift.
acceptance_criteria: All existing tests pass
Any failing assertions are fixed or documented
No unrelated behavior is changed

tasks.title: Extract shared conversion service
tasks.description: Move conversion orchestration out of the CLI into a reusable service that can support both CLI and UI flows.
acceptance_criteria: CLI calls the shared service
Service returns structured metadata
Service tests cover valid conversion, empty mask, invalid config, and mirroring

tasks.title: Add structured preview metadata
tasks.description: Expose image dimensions, physical dimensions, raised pixel count, total height, estimated complexity, and printmaking warnings.
acceptance_criteria: CLI preview uses structured metadata
Metadata is available without exporting STL when requested
Tests verify metadata values

tasks.title: Add input safety limits
tasks.description: Prevent oversized images and unbounded mesh generation from exhausting CPU or memory.
acceptance_criteria: Config supports maximum pixel count or dimensions
Oversized images fail with a clear error
Tests cover safety limit behavior

tasks.title: Optimize mesh generation
tasks.description: Use horizontal runs or rectangle merging to reduce geometry for large masks.
acceptance_criteria: Generated mesh remains watertight
Large solid masks produce substantially fewer faces than per-pixel geometry
Existing mesh tests pass
New tests cover sparse and dense masks

tasks.title: Build basic PNG upload UI
tasks.description: Create a UI for uploading a PNG, adjusting conversion parameters, previewing metadata, and downloading an STL.
acceptance_criteria: User can load a PNG from the UI
User can adjust threshold, scale, base thickness, relief height, and mirroring
UI displays preview metadata before export
User can download a generated STL
UI does not expose arbitrary filesystem paths

tasks.title: Add mask preview UI
tasks.description: Show the processed black/transparent mask so users can tune threshold and mirroring before export.
acceptance_criteria: Mask preview updates when threshold changes
Mirroring is reflected in the preview
Preview handles transparent backgrounds clearly

tasks.title: Add 3D preview
tasks.description: Render a browser-based preview of the generated relief mesh before download.
acceptance_criteria: Preview renders nonblank geometry
User can rotate or inspect the model
Large inputs degrade gracefully or show a complexity warning

tasks.title: Add printmaking reliability analysis
tasks.description: Detect thin raised features and warn when they may be fragile or hard to print.
acceptance_criteria: Analysis estimates minimum raised feature width
Warnings use millimeter units
Tests cover obvious thin-line cases

tasks.title: Add physical size presets
tasks.description: Provide presets and automatic scale calculation for common print sizes.
acceptance_criteria: User can choose common target sizes
Scale is calculated from desired width or height
Custom scale remains available

tasks.title: Add batch conversion
tasks.description: Support converting multiple PNG files with shared settings.
acceptance_criteria: Batch CLI or UI flow accepts multiple PNGs
Each output file has a predictable name
Failures are reported per input file
